warmups.name: Kettlebell Deadlift (Light)
warmups.precautions: Feet hip-width, soft bend in knees that stays;Flat back the whole time - spine long, chest up;Push hips BACK - weight slides close to legs
warmups.cues: Soft knees, push hips back;Flat back, weight close to legs;Stand tall by squeezing glutes

exercises.name: Leg Curl Machine
exercises.precautions: Elbows fixed at your sides - they do not move forward;Upper arms completely still - only forearms curl;Stand tall, no swinging from hips or back;Lower all the way to straight arms slowly
exercises.cues: Hips stay down on the pad;Curl heels toward you with control;Lower slowly all the way

steps.do: Hips stay down on the pad
Curl heels toward you with control

exercises.name: KB Romanian Deadlift
exercises.precautions: Feet hip-width, soft bend in knees that stays;Flat back the whole time - spine long, chest up;Push hips BACK - weight slides close to legs;Stand by squeezing glutes - no leaning back at top
exercises.cues: Soft knees, push hips back;Flat back, weight close to legs;Stand tall by squeezing glutes

steps.dont: Feet hip-width, soft bend in knees that stays

steps.do: Flat back, weight close to legs
steps.dont: Flat back the whole time - spine long, chest up
Stand by squeezing glutes - no leaning back at top

exercises.name: DB Staggered Romanian Deadlift
exercises.precautions: Feet hip-width, soft bend in knees that stays;Flat back the whole time - spine long, chest up;Push hips BACK - weight slides close to legs;Stand by squeezing glutes - no leaning back at top
exercises.cues: Soft knees, push hips back;Flat back, weight close to legs;Stand tall by squeezing glutes

steps.dont: Feet hip-width, soft bend in knees that stays

steps.do: Flat back, weight close to legs
steps.dont: Flat back the whole time - spine long, chest up
Stand by squeezing glutes - no leaning back at top

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.precautions: Back flat on seat pad, grip handles to stay still;Knees lined up with machine pivot point;Pad rests on back of ankles, not calves;No lifting hips off seat during the curl
exercises.cues: Sit tall, pad behind ankles;Curl heels down and back;Return slowly to the stretch

steps.dont: Back flat on seat pad, grip handles to stay still
No lifting hips off seat during the curl

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.precautions: Hips pressed flat into the pad the whole time;Knees lined up with machine pivot point;Curl smoothly - no jerking from lower back;Lower slowly until legs nearly straight
exercises.cues: Lie face-down, pad at ankles;Curl heels toward glutes;Lower slowly with control

steps.dont: Hips pressed flat into the pad the whole time
Curl smoothly - no jerking from lower back
Lower slowly until legs nearly straight

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.precautions: Face away from cable, feet hip-width, soft knees;Flat back the whole time - spine long, chest up;Push hips BACK toward the machine to lower;Stand by squeezing glutes - no leaning back
exercises.cues: Rope between legs, hinge back;Snap hips forward tall;Keep arms straight and relaxed

steps.dont: Push hips BACK toward the machine to lower
Stand by squeezing glutes - no leaning back

exercises.name: Standing Hamstring Curl
exercises.precautions: Hold a chair back or wall for balance;Bend one knee, heel toward your bottom;Thigh stays still and vertical - only the lower leg moves;Lower the foot slowly, no dropping
exercises.cues: Heel to bottom, thigh still;Squeeze the back of your thigh;Lower slowly, repeat, switch

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.precautions: Feet hip-width, knees soft - never locked;Hands lightly across your chest;Push your hips back with a flat back - chest stays open;Lower only until you feel a gentle stretch behind your thighs
exercises.cues: Hips back, flat back;Feel the stretch behind thighs;Push hips forward to stand

exercises.name: Windmill Touches
exercises.precautions: Feet wide, arms out like a windmill;Rotate and reach one hand to the opposite foot;Keep legs straight-ish with soft knees;Rise and alternate smoothly
exercises.cues: Arms wide like a windmill;Hand to opposite foot;Alternate sides

exercises.name: Supine Heel Swings
exercises.precautions: Lie on your back with legs extended;Swing one leg gently across and back, heel leading;Keep hips on the surface - small range is fine;Move slowly, no momentum jerks
exercises.cues: Legs long;Swing gently side to side;Hips stay down

exercises.name: DB Deadlift
exercises.precautions: Dumbbells start on the floor beside your feet;Hinge and grip, chest up, back flat before you lift;Stand by pushing the floor away, weights close to your legs;Lower by hinging, weights sliding down your thighs
exercises.cues: Flat back, chest up;Push the floor away;Weights stay close

steps.dont: Hinge and grip, chest up, back flat before you lift
Stand by pushing the floor away, weights close to your legs
Lower by hinging, weights sliding down your thighs

exercises.name: DB RDL to Front Squat
exercises.precautions: Hinge into a Romanian deadlift with dumbbells skimming your thighs;At the bottom, sit straight down into a front squat, weights racked;Stand tall, then flow into the next hinge;Two clean halves - never rush the transition
exercises.cues: Hinge low;Sit into the squat;Stand, repeat the flow

steps.dont: Hinge into a Romanian deadlift with dumbbells skimming your thighs
At the bottom, sit straight down into a front squat, weights racked
Stand tall, then flow into the next hinge

exercises.name: DB Deadlift to Overhead Press
exercises.precautions: Deadlift the dumbbells with a flat back;Roll them up to your shoulders as you stand;Press overhead with ribs down and glutes squeezed;Reverse the whole chain slowly
exercises.cues: Deadlift tall;Rack at shoulders;Press overhead, brace

exercises.name: Elephant Walk
exercises.precautions: Hinge forward with hands reaching toward the floor;Bend one knee while straightening the other, alternating like slow marching;Keep hips high and back long;Only straighten as far as a mild hamstring stretch
exercises.cues: Hinge, hands low;Straighten one leg at a time;Alternate slowly

exercises.name: Pancake Fold
exercises.precautions: Sit with legs wide, knees soft if needed;Hinge from the hips and walk hands forward between your feet;Keep your back as long as you can - reach, don't round hard;Come out slowly
exercises.cues: Legs wide, sit tall;Hinge and walk hands forward;Long back

exercises.name: Hip Flexor-Hamstring Flow (Foot Elevated)
exercises.precautions: One foot elevated on a chair seat, knee bent;Rock gently forward into the hip flexor stretch, then straighten the leg into a hamstring stretch;Flow between the two positions slowly;Hold the chair or a wall for balance
exercises.cues: Foot up on the chair;Rock forward, then straighten and hinge;Slow flow between stretches

exercises.name: DB Romanian Deadlift
exercises.precautions: Dumbbells skim your thighs as you hinge;Soft knees, hips push BACK - this is a hinge, not a squat;Back stays flat the whole way;Stop the descent at a strong hamstring stretch, then stand tall
exercises.cues: Hips back, weights skim thighs;Flat back;Stand tall, squeeze glutes

steps.dont: Dumbbells skim your thighs as you hinge
Back stays flat the whole way

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.precautions: Bar close to your shins, back flat, chest up;Hinge at the hips - never round your lower back;Lock out by standing tall, not by leaning back;Start light and add weight only with clean form
exercises.cues: Grip just outside your knees, brace hard;Push the floor away, bar slides up your thighs;Stand tall, lower with control

steps.do: Grip just outside your knees, brace hard
steps.dont: Bar close to your shins, back flat, chest up

steps.do: Push the floor away, bar slides up your thighs

steps.dont: Lock out by standing tall, not by leaning back

exercises.name: Resistance Band Deadlift
exercises.precautions: Stand on the band, feet hip-width, handles at your sides;Hinge with a flat back - never round;Keep tension on the band through the whole rep;Inspect the band for damage before use
exercises.cues: Hinge back with soft knees;Stand tall, squeezing your glutes;Lower with a flat back

steps.dont: Stand on the band, feet hip-width, handles at your sides
Hinge with a flat back - never round

exercises.name: Hamstring-to-Hip Flow
exercises.precautions: Move slowly between the hamstring stretch and the deep hip position;Keep your back long - hinge, do not round;Support yourself with hands on the floor or a block;Never force the hip or hamstring range
exercises.cues: Hinge into a hamstring stretch;Flow down into a deep squat hip opener;Alternate smoothly side to side

stretches.name: Hamstring Stretch
stretches.precautions: Move gently until you feel a mild stretch - never force;Breathe slowly and relax into it - no bouncing;Keep posture tall and supported where you can
stretches.cues: Move gently to a mild stretch;Breathe slowly, never force it
